summary: Lee County, AL tower erected in 1948 by Alabama Forestry Commission personnel, one of two built for the county; NHLR-registered 2009. Staffing and current access not documented.

facts.design: 100' Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with 7'x7' steel cab

events.note: Erected by Alabama Forestry Commission personnel as one of two Lee County fire towers
Salem Lookout Tower, the second Lee County tower, was built this year and has since been dismantled (not this lookout)
Registered December 2, 2009 as US 842, AL 21; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

notes_for_editor: Built year, design, elevation, registration and the Salem note all come from the NHLR register entry alone; no second source for the build. The register's 'only surviving' wording implies standing when written, but the date is unknown, so the record's 'standing' status is not independently confirmed. No staffing, fire, access or current-condition source found. Wikipedia's Beauregard article does not mention the tower. The Forestry Commission homepage and the FFLOS Alabama page gave nothing useful. The 1819 column does not name this tower; it is used only for statewide context and the climbing warning. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 7 page reads.
